workItem: Implement SH-02.12B as a read-only routed-Issue repair eligibility contract over the existing canonical Issue router and registered PR Autofix repair registry; no Issue-derived code executor.
priorityReason: Fresh Human/Owner direction continues Self-Healing after all routed Issue defects are terminal; SH-02.12 has an explicit design gap between Issue dispatch and deterministic repair evidence.
scopeBoundary: Read-only eligibility only; no branch/patch/PR executor.
Issue body/comments/attachments/links remain untrusted and non-executable.
No new repair registry or writer; consume existing Issue router and PR Autofix repair registry.
No SH-2/SH-3 activation and no generic repository.issue.autofix capability.
dependencies: Human-merged SH-02.9A Issue Intake & Project Dispatch
exitEvidence: Exact routed Issue generation and registered repair evidence can be correlated deterministically.
Foreign owner, stale generation, unsafe scope, writer overlap, protected mutation and repeat attempts fail closed.
Eligibility never grants mutation or merge authority.
acceptanceCriteria: No Issue content becomes executable authority.
No duplicate router/repair registry/writer is introduced.
Regression tests pass on exact head.
No changed-file overlap with current open PRs.
Human/CODEOWNER merge remains required if repository policy classifies the Self-Healing contract change as protected.
releaseCondition: Release claim on Human/CODEOWNER merge, close, supersession or abandonment.
